steps: 1. Restart the game, enter the Keep, and open Hero View.
2. Read the two injected Compendium tabs. They must say **Armory** and **Bestiary**.
3. Switch into each one, return to a vanilla tab, then close and reopen Hero View and read the two tabs again.
4. Confirm the tab strip still contains exactly one Armory tab and one Bestiary tab after the reopen.
5. Attach the newest log; it must contain the line `[gut:217] compendium tabs injected into HeroWindowPanelConsole definitions (Armory, Bestiary)` exactly once.
assertions: Both tabs read **Armory** and **Bestiary** on first open and after reopening. They never show an internal key, an angle-bracket marker, blank text, uppercase-mangled text, or a duplicated tab, and the `[gut:217]` injection line appears exactly once in the log.
Export _resolve_label; unit-test valid string, bare key, empty, <key> sentinel all yield the literal fallback; assert injected widgets carry literal text.
